text: The purpose of this report is to advise the General Government and Licensing Committee of the Contracts valued over $20 million awarded in 2020 under the extended authority of the Bid Award Panel in accordance with the Section 195-8.3, A and B of the Municipal Code, Chapter 195, Purchasing. This report covers both Contract awards when Committees and Council were cancelled due to COVID-19 and then during the summer recess in 2020.
The General Government and Licensing Committee received the report (March 15, 2021) from the Chief Procurement Officer for information.
